verdict.tagline: Deep champion builds buried under technical issues and stalled updates.
for_you_if: you love deep loadout customization and distinct champion playstyles
you play on older hardware that handles the game well
not_for_you_if: you are a new player facing experienced opponents right away
you encounter account linking problems or lost progress
you experience severe server disconnections and random crashes

claims.claim: Reviewers describe new player queues as being filled with smurfs and experienced players rather than true beginners.

citations.review_text:
Quite unfriendly for new players, very overstimulating with a lot of stuff happening and while there is a "new player queue" its filled with smurfs (skilled players on new accounts) considering that you are willing to spend around 15+ minutes in queue (in EU region) and trying to load into a normal game of capture the point and payload you don't get a good feel of how to win aside from coin flipping fights and hoping you win. The game is 8 years old and doesn't seem to get many new players so I recommend giving it a try but keep expectations low. For improvements I would recommend a more immersive tutorial with a few more heros's rather than showing a very basic character that has grenades and a basic assault rifle with iron-sights, it also throws new players into the deep end with 15+ hero's with a wide range of abilities that they are trying to both pilot and fight against.

Specs Needed : Very low (my PC is 8 years old and runs the game well)
Graphics : Alright, not cinematic material and you wont be able to react to abilities as they are being cast but not bad
Player base: No interaction in chat at all (no messages sent by anyone) but filled with people on smurf accounts (level 10 and below but are obviously not new, for reference i got to level 5 with my time played).

I don't recommend trying until a more full flushed tutorial is done but its been 8 years so I doubt that's going to happen. So it may be to your liking but for a casual player trying to play a game like this I would recommend Overwatch or Smite instead although they each have their problems.

I really wouldn't recommend this game for new players. It wasn't very beginner friendly and almost every match I got into was against players with hundreds of hours, so our team got steamrolled constantly.

claims.claim: Returning players encounter account linking problems that result in lost progress and being reset to level 1.

citations.review_text:
Used to play, it was fun, characters have fun designs, all of that is great. But the friction to get to playing, especially if you are a returning player is just off-putting. Both on Smite and on this, whenever i'd returned after a long pause, all unlocked content was gone and i was reset back to lvl 1. Made me stop playing their games all together. Figured that there might be some silly reason for it.
So i looked it up, and people are having similar problems. Supposedly, the issue is linking hi-rez and steam accounts. So i went for it, making an actual hi-rez account. But linking just simply doesn't seem to work. Tried a different browser, just to be on the save side. Still nothing. Again, went searching for people with the same problem "so is this fixed yet?"
Screw this.

Overall I loved this game, it was great, fun and free alternative when compared to overwatch and I did enjoy playing it...   7 years ago.

but the more updates it got, the worse the game has gotten, first, they removed kill cam, which is fine, it was often wrong anyways, so whatever, but then they decided to remove play of the game, which was honestly one of my favourite features in the game, but no, they simply removed it, and in benefit of what? 

Honestly no clue, because if it was for optimization.. well then they somehow made it only worse, it's honestly surprising how the most difficult part of this game is figuring out which settings my pc can safely start the game for it to run smoothly at 165 fps or at the very least 60fps, without looking at characters made of 100 or smh polygons. which is surprising considering 7 years ago I had a pc that was already 10yrs old by that time and was capable of running the game pretty smoothly

Ok, well if the game hasn't been optimized maybe they fixed the countless bugs that this game had... right.. riiight?

Well.. I guess this part has changed for sure, but not in a good way, because there's actually even more bugs, or maybe I have just gotten better at finding them, who knows, either way, the amount of bugs is insane, bk's grumpy bomb just spawns at the spot where it would land, without seeing it's trajectory, zhin's counter working only sometimes, you can still receive damage from vivian that is in front of you without ever procking counter, kinessas tp suddenly letting you tp in the middle of the air for no reason and that's just the tip of it, there's plenty of bugs like these. And dear god, do not even try playing this game if you have multiple monitors, this game will mess up, should you tab out of it. In my case it for some reason decided to go on to the second monitor for no reason after tabbing out with messed up button collisions, and even the life saving shift+windows+arrow key, didn't help me getting it back …

citations.review_text: fun game but sometimes you can go on long lose streaks because of terrible match making

[h1]👍 Recommended – 300+ Hours Later, I'm Still Playing[/h1]

After [b]300+ hours[/b], I can confidently say that [b]Paladins[/b] is one of the most enjoyable hero shooters I've ever played. It has its own identity thanks to the [i]Loadout[/i] and [i]Card[/i] system, allowing you to customize champions around your own playstyle instead of everyone using the exact same build.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]My Favorite Champions[/h2]

• [b]Ruckus[/b] – An aggressive frontline champion that's incredibly fun once you learn how to dive the enemy backline and create chaos.

• [b]Seris[/b] – One of the most satisfying support champions in the game. Great healing, excellent survivability, and the ability to completely turn a team fight around.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Performance[/h2]

One of my favorite things about Paladins is how well it performs. Even if you have an [b]older PC or a low-end GPU[/b], the game runs surprisingly well while still looking good. It's refreshing to see a competitive multiplayer game that doesn't require expensive hardware just to enjoy smooth gameplay.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]The Good[/h2]

• [b]Free-to-play[/b] without feeling impossible to enjoy.
• Huge variety of unique champions.
• Deep customization with cards and talents.
• Fast-paced and rewarding gameplay.
• Excellent performance on lower-end hardware.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]The Not So Good[/h2]

No game is perfect.

Sometimes the matchmaking can feel uneven, and every now and then you'll run into bugs or balance issues. They can be frustrating, but they haven't stopped me from coming back for hundreds of hours.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]

If you're looking for a hero shooter that's easy to get into, offers plenty of replayability, and runs well on almost any PC, [b]Paladins is absolutely worth playing.[/b]

After more than [b]300 hours[/b], I'm still queueing up for "just one more match."

[b]Rating: 9/10[/b] 👍

I'll preface my review by stating that like few handful of people, I've played since the open beta around late 2016-2017. Unlike a majority of people however, I've played paladins since then on almost all platforms it has ever been available on, not because I love paladins that much even though I do but because it was what I could access it on during those periods. Collectively over the years, my total amount of playtime hours are closer to 7-8k hours

I say that to say despite everything, and I mean everything this game has gone through, there is no worse state that paladins has been in, more than now.

This game has a very recent specific bug unlike anything I've ever experienced, and have tolerated and still struggle to tolerate today. 

 After you, your team and the opposing team have successfully locked in your champions for a match and have been queued onto loading screen, they is a slight chance (say a 30% chance) you will be reverted back to the champion selection page, which renders you unable to do literally anything but force close the game. 

Unlike many, if you decided to launch paladins again and be placed back into the loading screen for the ongoing match that is probably already a "lost cause", there is another say 30%  chance you will be reverted back to the homescreen which (you guessed it) is glitched and also renders you unable to do anything but force close the game for the second time. 

I personally have experienced this "bug" numerous of times, and for others that join the match normally, if you notice your teammate has disconnected literally as soon as the map loads, they probably had this bug. I personally have had to close and re-launch paladins three times because of this bug, and by that point your match has already ended, or you're currently down 0:3 with teammates that have either willingly left or have had this bug happen to them and simply refused to re-launch paladins again.
